dataset.description: The website shows 1-3 copied public thumbnails per category while CNN similarities are computed from all images in every category folder.

vgg16.label: VGG16
vgg16.aggregation: All images in each category folder are passed through the pretrained model, pooled at the selected layer, L2-normalized per image, and category-pair similarity is computed as the mean cosine across all cross-category image pairs.

layers.label: block1_conv2
layers.descriptor: Early VGG16 features group categories through local texture and contrast patterns.

layers.label: block2_conv2
layers.descriptor: Contour-level cues begin to separate rigid, curved, and textured object families.

layers.label: block3_conv3
layers.descriptor: Mid-level VGG16 layers emphasize reusable parts and larger local motifs.

layers.label: block4_conv3
layers.descriptor: Later VGG16 layers reflect broader semantic neighborhoods between categories.

layers.label: block5_conv2
layers.descriptor: Category identity becomes more stable and cross-category gaps are easier to interpret.

layers.label: block5_conv3
layers.descriptor: The deepest selected VGG16 layer emphasizes semantic grouping over surface appearance.

alexnet.label: AlexNet
alexnet.aggregation: All images in each category folder are passed through the pretrained model, pooled at the selected layer, L2-normalized per image, and category-pair similarity is computed as the mean cosine across all cross-category image pairs.

layers.label: conv1
layers.descriptor: The first AlexNet layer emphasizes broad structure and strong low-level contrast.

layers.label: conv2
layers.descriptor: Second-layer AlexNet features reinforce contour and repeated texture groupings.

layers.label: conv3
layers.descriptor: Mid-level AlexNet features capture larger part combinations and recurring motifs.

layers.label: conv4
layers.descriptor: Later AlexNet layers reflect stronger category-level motifs and part arrangements.

layers.label: conv5
layers.descriptor: The deepest AlexNet convolutional map emphasizes coarse semantic identity.

convnextv2.label: ConvNeXt V2
convnextv2.aggregation: All images in each category folder are passed through ConvNeXt V2, the selected stage is flattened across channels and spatial positions, L2-normalized per image, and category-pair similarity is computed as the mean cosine across all cross-category image pairs.

layers.label: stage1
layers.descriptor: Early ConvNeXt V2 features retain local texture structure with modern normalization and downsampling.

layers.label: stage2
layers.descriptor: Mid-level ConvNeXt V2 representations strengthen recurring parts and meso-scale structure.

layers.label: stage3
layers.descriptor: Later ConvNeXt V2 stages organize categories through broader semantic part composition.

layers.label: stage4
layers.descriptor: The deepest selected ConvNeXt V2 stage emphasizes high-level category neighborhoods.
